reasoning: Modular vision transformer framework for weed segmentation from drone video in precision agriculture, with specialized preprocessing for blur/noise degradation on UAV images; abstract explicitly states advancement in DL applications for agriculture with segmentation quality improvements over CNN baselines, satisfying INC-01 (UAV weed pixel segmentation) and INC-02 (quantitative segmentation quality metrics).

Low-cost mini-drone (DJI Mini 2 SE) agricultural monitoring system using U-Net semantic segmentation and YOLOvX on a 300m² vegetable plot, reporting >90% detection accuracy; the U-Net performs pixel-level segmentation of vegetation/land from UAV imagery, satisfying INC-01 and INC-02, though the paper is more system-level than a pure segmentation benchmark.

Lightweight CNN models (MobileNetV4-Seg, DeepLabv3+, SSD) for real-time weed detection and semantic segmentation deployed on edge devices (Jetson Nano, Jetson Orin Nano) using UAV RGB images of corn and soybean fields; reports IoUs of 69.9%/76.8%, F1 of 82.3%/86.9%, and 44 FPS on Jetson Orin Nano, fully satisfying INC-01/02/03.

The paper's primary contribution is coverage path planning optimization for herbicide spraying (66.3% route-time reduction via GA-based TSPWR); semantic segmentation using DeepLab v3+ serves only as preprocessing to identify weed patches in sugarcane, and no pixel-level segmentation accuracy metrics (mIoU/Dice/F1/PA) are reported anywhere in the paper.

AgriFusion dual-encoder framework for RGB-NIR semantic segmentation in airborne agricultural imagery using UAV data, evaluated on Agriculture-Vision dataset; reports mIoU 49.31%, PA 81.72%, F1 67.85% for crop anomaly segmentation, outperforming SegFormer/DeepLab/AAFormer baselines, satisfying INC-01/02.

DM_CorrMatch semi-supervised framework using Mamba-DeepLabv3+ for rapeseed flower coverage segmentation from UAV imagery on the RFSD dataset (720 UAV images); reports IoU 0.886 with automatic label-update strategy, satisfying INC-01 (UAV crop pixel-level segmentation) and INC-02 (quantitative IoU metric).

Comparative study of DeepLabV3+ with five backbones (VGG16/ResNet50/ResNet101/Xception/MobileNetV2) for crop semantic segmentation from UAV remote sensing, reporting pixel accuracy, IoU, and Dice metrics alongside memory and inference speed; MobileNetV2 identified as most suitable for UAV edge deployment, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

HRS-UNet hyperspectral segmentation network for precise crop classification from UAV hyperspectral imagery on the UAV-HSI-Crop dataset; reports overall classification accuracy 89.96% and Kappa 0.8814, achieving SOTA crop pixel-level segmentation, satisfying INC-01/02.

Low-cost UAV system with onboard Jetson Nano running Squeeze U-Net semantic segmentation for real-time weed detection in salad crops; introduces the AgriAdapt UAV dataset (643 images) and reports ~90% segmentation accuracy across multiple architectures, with latency and energy efficiency on the edge device, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

SqueezeSlimU-Net (SSU-Net) adaptive slimmable U-Net for real-time UAV weed detection, tested on two UAV-collected datasets and an edge computing platform; reports energy consumption reduction up to 65% with minimal 2% accuracy drop, achieving on-par segmentation performance with fewer parameters than SOTA models, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

AgroVisionNet hybrid CNN/ViT/GNN framework evaluated across five benchmarks including the UAV Crop and Weed dataset for weed segmentation; reports 94.5% accuracy on UAV Crop and Weed with 95.6% IoU on Agriculture-Vision for crop anomaly segmentation, satisfying INC-01/02.

Curated UAV dataset (WeedyRice-RGBMS-DB) of 734 RGB+multispectral images with expert polygon masks for semantic segmentation of weedy rice in Vietnam Mekong Delta rice fields; provides pixel-level ground-truth masks specifically for UAV crop/weed segmentation research, satisfying INC-01 and serving as a benchmark enabler.

The task is agricultural field boundary delineation (separating farmland boundaries from non-boundary pixels), not crop vs. weed pixel-level segmentation; the model segments boundary lines across four farmland types using the Winter UAV dataset, which is a geospatial field-mapping task rather than crop/weed classification per INC-01.

MSEA-Net lightweight multi-scale edge-aware network for weed segmentation; achieves mIoU 87.42% on Motion-Blurred UAV sorghum fields dataset and 71.35% on CoFly-WeedDB, with 6.74M parameters/25.74 MB model size for UAV real-time deployment, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

Novel framework integrating UAV-based super-resolution reconstruction (RCAN) with semantic segmentation using CNN, Transformer, and Mamba architectures for tobacco crop vs. weed differentiation; reports top ensemble mIoU of 90.75% and releases annotated dataset, satisfying INC-01/02.

U-Net variants (standard, attention, ResNet-augmented, SCSE-embedded) compared against DeepLabV3+ for semantic segmentation of weeds, crops, and bare soil from low-altitude multispectral UAV imagery on WeedsGalore dataset; best weed-class IoU 77.49% with 21.1% parameter reduction, satisfying INC-01/02.

Mask R-CNN applied to identify and segment sugarcane leaf rust disease-infected areas on leaves from UAV multispectral imagery (best F1 0.70 at 5m altitude); the task is plant disease lesion segmentation rather than crop vs. weed pixel-level segmentation, falling under EXC-03 (disease-classification domain).

MSU-Net for semantic segmentation of buckwheat weeds from UAV multispectral imagery, comparing band combinations; reports mIoU 0.65, Dice 0.85, F1 0.78 across multiband configurations on minor grain crop, satisfying INC-01 (UAV crop/weed segmentation) and INC-02 (pixel-level metrics).

MSCNN-VSS model for multiscale crop disease detection/segmentation from UAV imagery, achieving PA 0.9421 and mIoU 0.9152; the task is disease symptom pixel-level segmentation rather than crop vs. weed discrimination, falling under EXC-03 (disease-classification domain).

U-Net with spectral indices and DSM geometry for quantitative disease assessment (Cercospora infection) in sugar beet from UAV multispectral imagery; reports infected-class F1 46.0%, healthy 92.5%, overall 88.6% accuracy; the primary task is disease infection segmentation, not crop vs. weed segmentation, falling under EXC-03.

Evaluates resolution-accuracy trade-offs for semantic segmentation of agricultural anomalies (dryness, nutrient deficiency) on Agriculture-Vision UAV dataset using U-Net/R2U-Net/U-Net3+/Attention U-Net/DeepLabV3+ with mIoU/Dice metrics across three GSD levels; DL UAV agricultural pixel segmentation with explicit quantitative metrics, satisfying INC-01/02.

YOLOv11 instance segmentation (YOLOv11n-seg, YOLOv11s-seg) for crop, weed, and soil segmentation from UAV imagery, with INT8 quantization deployed on Rockchip RK3588 NPU (Orange Pi 5+); reports 2.6-2.7x latency reduction with ~2-3pt accuracy loss, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

Improved U-Net with dual-headed output (vegetation + crop masks, weed derived as difference) for crop and weed segmentation in tobacco plantations, using ConvNeXtV2/FastViT/RepViT/MambaVision backbones; reports best Dice 94.24% crop and 93.72% weed from drone-acquired dataset (Mavic Mini), satisfying INC-01/02.

Mask R-CNN (ResNet101) for identification and segmentation of Phytophthora infestans late blight lesions on potato leaflets from Phantom 4 Pro drone imagery (73.5% effectiveness at leaflet level); the task is crop disease lesion segmentation, not crop vs. weed pixel-level segmentation, falling under EXC-03.

U-Net for semantic segmentation of coffee canopies from UAV multispectral imagery on a commercial coffee farm in Brazil; reports Dice 0.89, IoU 0.83, accuracy >0.92. Coffee is a perennial fruit tree crop grown in orchards, and the task is canopy delineation rather than crop vs. weed segmentation, falling under EXC-03 (fruit/orchard exclusion).

DAS-SK lightweight CNN architecture with selective kernel convolutions and enhanced ASPP for agricultural semantic segmentation, evaluated on PhenoBench (crop/weed segmentation benchmark) alongside LandCover.ai and VDD; designed for UAV/edge deployment with 21x fewer parameters than transformer models, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

RPD-Net lightweight reparameterized pixel-difference network for efficient crop-weed semantic segmentation on drone-acquired Phenobench dataset (IoU ~70) and CoFly dataset; reports 42 FPS on RTX 3090 and 7 FPS on Jetson TX2, satisfying INC-01/02/03.

PCCSAN-based DenseNet121 U-Net for semantic weed segmentation and classification from UAV-captured sorghum field imagery; reports 98.76% F1-score and 96.56% mIoU, outperforming state-of-the-art models, satisfying INC-01/02.
